layers.title: Hard board
layers.what: Life-like rules where the neighbours are hidden: only the 4 sides, only the diagonals, knight moves, or 2 squares along a row. Work out which squares count, then apply it to big grids.

layers.title: Many steps
layers.what: Apply the rule 3 times in a row. One early slip spreads.

layers.title: Trap
layers.what: The rule is one number off the famous Game of Life. The examples show the difference. Most fails used the famous rule anyway.

layers.title: Fix the slip
layers.what: Given a near-miss answer and told exactly how many squares are wrong, fix it.

layers.title: Tables (control)
layers.what: The same test on tables of numbers, up to 48 rows. Everyone does well, so the grid failures are about 2D, not maths.
